analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — geopolitical shock, asymmetric session timing

SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed at ₩1,582,000 on 2026-08-03, down ₩136,000 / −7.92% from the July 31 historic close of ₩1,718,000 (= day high). Day range: ₩1,563,000 (session low) to ₩1,645,000 (session high). The session structure reflected the adverse timing of the geopolitical shock: the KRX session ran 00:00–06:30 UTC (9:00AM–3:30PM KST), entirely BEFORE President Trump's mid-US-session Iran strike cancellation announcement (approximately 14:00 UTC). Korean investors experienced only the risk-off phase of the geopolitical event; the recovery phase played out entirely in US markets after the KRX had closed.

### Context: post-+30%-day consolidation meets geopolitical catalyst

The July 31 dossier explicitly warned of this scenario: '+29.95% single-day move creates near-term consolidation risk; technicians will cite the blow-off pattern and expect a retest of lower levels before the next leg.' The geopolitical catalyst (US-Iran strikes) provided the trigger. The −7.92% session reduces the cumulative two-day position gain for July 30 framework BUY traders (₩1,322,000 entry) from +29.95% to: $1,582,000 − $1,322,000 = +₩260,000 / +19.7% — still a significant gain.

Post-earnings recovery scorecard:
- July 29–30 selloff trough: ₩1,322,000 (−14.7% from pre-earnings ₩1,550,000)
- July 31 recovery peak: ₩1,718,000 (+29.95% from trough; +10.8% above pre-earnings)
- August 3 geopolitical selloff: ₩1,582,000 (−7.92% from peak; +2.1% above pre-earnings)

The net result: SK Hynix is still +₩32,000 / +2.1% above the pre-earnings reference close. The market's verdict on the Q2 2026 earnings remains positive — the 'revenue miss was a timing issue' narrative has not been reversed by today's geopolitical selloff.

### Trend — post-30%-day distribution with geopolitical catalyst; thesis intact

The near-term trend is distributive: peak at ₩1,718,000 (July 31 close = day high) → single session reversal to ₩1,582,000 (−7.92%). This is a textbook 'shooting star' pattern on the weekly chart — large body up on the highest volume in months, then an immediate high-volume reversal session. Technicians will flag this as a distribution signal. However, the counterargument is strong: (1) the reversal was driven by an exogenous macro shock (US-Iran military escalation), not SK Hynix-specific news; (2) ₩1,582,000 is still above the pre-earnings reference (₩1,550,000); (3) the US market recovered fully after the KRX closed, removing the fundamental basis for continued selling.

### Volume — circuit-breaker-level; driven by forced selling, not fundamental selling

Volume was estimated well above the 3-month average, consistent with a circuit-breaker session for the KOSPI. The nature of the volume matters: KOSPI circuit-breaker sessions are characterized by forced selling — margin calls from leveraged accounts, stop-loss triggers from algorithmic strategies, and institutional risk-off position reduction on geopolitical uncertainty. This is NOT the same as informed selling based on SK Hynix fundamental analysis. Circuit-breaker-volume sessions in fundamentally sound large-caps historically attract foreign institutional re-entry in the following 1–3 sessions as the geopolitical noise recedes.

### Momentum — shooting star / distribution pattern; watch ₩1,550,000 as the key support

The two-day candle structure is adverse: July 31 (large bullish body from ₩1,586,000 to ₩1,718,000 = day high close) followed by August 3 (day range ₩1,563,000–₩1,645,000, close near low at ₩1,582,000). This creates a 'bearish engulfing' or 'shooting star' weekly pattern. The key technical question for the week: does ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference close, July 28) hold as support? A close below ₩1,550,000 would indicate that the geopolitical panic selling extended beyond the post-earnings recovery premium and re-opened the 'fundamental miss' narrative. Above ₩1,550,000, the thesis remains intact.

### ★ Strongest support — ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference, now the thesis-validity floor)

With the ₩1,586,000 support from July 31 technically breached (by ₩4,000), the next meaningful support is ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference close, July 28). This level carries the most strategic significance in the current framework:
1. Pre-earnings reference: a close BELOW ₩1,550,000 means the market has completely unwound the post-earnings re-rating premium; a close ABOVE means the market still believes the Q2 revenue miss was a timing issue and not a demand deterioration
2. Former resistance converted to support: ₩1,550,000 was the ceiling before Q2 earnings; after the +29.95% July 31 session, it became support
3. Institutional cost basis: investors who held through the earnings cycle at ₩1,550,000 will defend this level to protect their break-even

Currently ₩32,000 / +2.1% above today's close. Distance is thin enough to be tested on Tuesday if Iran risks re-escalate or if broader KOSPI selling continues.

### ★ Strongest resistance — ₩1,867,213 (framework gate)

### What invalidates the bull read

A KRX close below ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference) would signal the post-earnings re-rating has been fully unwound — the 'Q2 revenue miss was a timing issue' thesis would need re-evaluation. A close below ₩1,322,000 (July 30 framework trough) would be the hardest invalidation — it would mean the entire post-earnings recovery has been reversed, which would require either a fundamental demand deterioration (HBM4 cancellations, hyperscaler capex reversal) or a macro event far more severe than the US-Iran geopolitical shock (e.g., direct Korean Peninsula military risk). Neither of those scenarios is indicated by today's available information.
